content.text: Hey ███. Hope your off-season is going well. Would you be willing to talk about the new hitting coach job, your philosophies, etc.?
I was thinking an interesting angle would be talking to Terrin about what you taught him growing up, if that’s possible
Hi Antony, I’m in the DR working with our players for the week. I’d love to talk shop with you, anytime. What works for you?
Thanks for getting back to me. I am still in Europe, so I’m six hours ahead. If you have time tonight, that would work.
